module: GE extension `core_vehicle_thumbnail`: generates the thumbnails (.jpg) of saved vehicle configurations, either directly in vehicles/<model>/<config>.jpg, or as a temporary preview capture (folder /screenshots/vehicleConfigTemp) that the user can accept or cancel before saving. Delegates the shot to util_screenshotCreator_currentConfigThumbnail. Used by core_vehicle_partmgmt.
usage:
local r = core_vehicle_thumbnail.captureTemporaryThumbnail()
if r.success then
  -- the UI receives the guihook VehicleConfigThumbnailPreviewReady {captureId, success, path}
end
-- on save:
core_vehicle_thumbnail.commitTemporaryThumbnail(r.captureId, 'vehicles/pickup/my_config.jpg')
notes: Temporary captures are tracked by an increasing numeric identifier (captureId). The guihook VehicleConfigThumbnailPreviewReady is emitted with {captureId, success, path?} at the end of each capture.
The file copy is atomic: copy to a .tmp, optional backup of the old file as .bak, then rename; restore on failure.
generateThumbnail uses `vehicle.jbeam or vehicle.JBeam` for the model name (both cases tested).

generateConfigThumbnail.desc: Generates the thumbnail of the named config for the configured vehicle, in vehicles/<model>/<name>.jpg, via util_screenshotCreator_currentConfigThumbnail.

configName.desc: config name (path and .pc/.jpg extensions are removed)

captureTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Starts a temporary capture (preview) for the configured vehicle's current config; the file is /screenshots/vehicleConfigTemp/save-preview-<id>.jpg.

returns.desc: {success = true, captureId, path} or {success = false, reason = 'noCurrentConfig'|'busy'}

getTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Returns the most recent ready temporary capture.

returns.desc: {captureId, path} or {path = nil} if there is none

cancelTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Cancels a capture (deletes the file; if it is still in progress, it will be deleted when it finishes).

clearTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Cancels a specific capture, or all of them if captureId is nil.

isValidTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Indicates whether the path matches a temporary capture that is ready, not canceled and existing.

copyThumbnailFile.desc: Copies a thumbnail file to a destination, safely replacing the old one (creates the folder if needed).

commitTemporaryThumbnail.desc: Commits a ready capture: copies it to targetPath then deletes the temporary file.
